name: waibi-sabi-os
description: Operating knowledge and session rituals for the wAIbi-sabi blog OS — the Notion-controlled, routine-driven Astro publishing system that lives in this repo. Surfaces the HANDOFF / PUBLISHING / ARTWORK / LESSONS knowledge on demand, packages the session-start, status, doctor, dashboard, verify, ship and handoff rituals as commands, and guards the two rules that must never break (never set Draft Status = Approved; never commit to the notion/approved-articles branch).
